issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按卡片 md 抓到 20f——百叶窗波（20–52f）一帧都没进画，看到的只是一张静止页面
条内 A/B 只是横向 scaleX 挤压，叶片没有任何受光变化，读作两张图在横向压扁，不像叶片翻面
翻换中的相邻叶片之间没有缝，十二条切片在运动中糊成一整块
缝亮线的暗描边用纯黑 rgba(0,0,0,0.55)，与 Phase 0 页面的带色相深色不协调
changes: 补 BLINDS_SLICE_DURATION = 150（前态 20 + 波 32 + 真静止 98）；12×160 竖条、列号×2f 错峰、每条 10f Easing.in(cubic)、交接缝 x+160(1-p)、52f 摘罩全部保持
叶片受光：翻走的 A 面随 √p 转暗、翻来的 B 面从暗处转亮，阴影沿叶宽横向渐变（A 远端右缘最深 0.34、B 远端左缘最深 0.32，#10121a），切片读作绕铰边侧过去的叶片
翻换中的叶片两缘各补 1px 发丝分隔线（rgba(16,18,26,0.22)），与缝亮线同步 2f 淡入淡出，只在该条翻换时出现
缝亮线三层参数（16px 白 0.45 / 6px 暗 0.55 / 3px 白核）照旧，暗描边改带色相的 rgba(10,11,18,0.55)
issuesEn: No duration constant; the workbench picked 20f from the card md, so the blinds wave (20–52f) never appeared — viewers saw a static page
Inside each strip A and B were just squashed with scaleX and had no lighting change, reading as two images being compressed rather than slats turning
Adjacent turning slats had no gap between them, so the twelve strips merged into one block in motion
The seam's dark outline was pure black rgba(0,0,0,0.55), clashing with the tinted darks of the Phase 0 page
changesEn: Added BLINDS_SLICE_DURATION = 150 (20 lead-in + 32 wave + 98 true hold); the 12×160 strips, column×2f stagger, 10f Easing.in(cubic) per strip, x+160(1-p) seam and 52f unmount are unchanged

Slat lighting: the departing A face darkens with √p and the arriving B face brightens out of shadow, with shading graded across the slat width (A's far right edge up to 0.34, B's far left edge up to 0.32, #10121a), so strips read as slats turning on a hinge
Turning slats get a 1px hairline divider on both edges (rgba(16,18,26,0.22)), fading in/out over 2f with the seam light and present only while that strip turns
The three seam-light layers (16px white 0.45 / 6px dark 0.55 / 3px white core) keep their values; the dark outline is now the tinted rgba(10,11,18,0.55)
